title: Ramsey number R(8,12), lower bound
statement: Find a two-colouring of the edges of K_n with no red K_8 and no blue K_12; it shows R(8,12) > n. The best known lower bound is R(8,12) >= 519, so a colouring of K_518 is known and one of K_519 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the n x n adjacency matrix of the red graph, one line of n characters 0/1 per vertex (1 red, 0 blue), symmetric with a zero diagonal; n <= 2048.

best_known.source: R(8,12) >= 519: Canli, Zenodo 23920916; Small Ramsey Numbers rev. 18 printed blank; read 5 Nov 2026
